about: Released StrokeNet weights (kit/strokenet.py). Weights are not in git; kit.strokenet.resolve_weights downloads a named model once into ~/.cache/scrolls-kit/strokenet (or $KIT_STROKENET_WEIGHTS) and refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. Every score is model output, not a reading.

strokenet-paris4-v1.input: the organisers' ink predictions on their 0 to 255 scale; an integer map at a whole fraction of 0.048 mm is pooled exactly as the training windows, and windows under 99 % core papyrus are skipped
